insight: Founded by Nutanix co-founder Dheeraj Pandey; its July 2024 Series A debuted DevRev as a $1.15B unicorn.
name: DevRev
tagline: AI-native platform unifying customer support and software development on one knowledge graph.
description: DevRev is an AI-native platform that connects customer support and product development on a single knowledge graph, so support conversations, tickets, and engineering work live in one system. Its AI agents resolve support requests, power enterprise search, and automate service-desk and product workflows, with analytics and an agent-building studio on top. The company positions its current flagship agent product, 'Computer,' as a team-wide assistant built on that graph.
edge: Unifies customer support and product development on one knowledge graph, so resolved issues flow straight to engineering — most rivals automate support alone.
pros: One system for support and engineering
AI agents for tickets and search
cons: Broad scope means a learning curve

references.title: DevRev Raises $100M Series A At $1.1B Valuation
